finding.title: The `push` method does not check if the `cnt` exceeds `maxLen` before writing to `arr[cnt]`.
The destructor `~Stack()` will attempt to delete the array `arr` even if it was not initialized.
The `pop` method returns `emptyValue` if the stack is empty.
